laws.rule: Defensores del Chaco National Park, extending into Alto Paraguay and Boquerón: arrange express MADES permission before entering. Visits to the absolute-protection zone require authorisation and ranger accompaniment; do not organise an unapproved expedition. The park page publishes no fixed public visiting hours and describes ranger-controlled access. Its camping option does not override protected-zone access restrictions.

sources.title: Defensores del Chaco absolute-protection-zone permission reminder
sources.supports: Read directly: MADES permission and ranger accompaniment for the absolute-protection zone; no unapproved expeditions.
